headline: Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy Flare Amid Heavy Northern Combat
war_summary: Fierce fighting along the northern and central fronts continues to generate high casualties, even as several earlier hot spots cool down. Over the past three hours, Stonecradle has largely fallen quiet following its earlier flurry of base captures, shifting tactical momentum toward Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy. Weathered Expanse recorded seven base transitions in the last two hours alone amidst bitter fighting around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, while Linn of Mercy logged four fresh exchanges centered on Outwich Ranch and Rotdust. To the northwest, Mooring County and Callum's Cape remain locked in grinding attrition; Mooring County absorbed over thirty-six hundred combined casualties alongside five strategic shifts, while Callum's Cape reported more than thirty-four hundred losses across Naofa and Scout's Jest. Meanwhile, Marban Hollow exhibits sharply accelerating casualty rates despite static front lines, and an isolated island action in Lykos Isle saw The Squall fall into Warden hands.
